 Ms. Pallavi Sharma, Assisting counsel to  Mr. Ravinder Gupta, AAG  Coram: HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE MOKSHA KHAJURIA KAZMI, JUDGE  ORDER 09.10.2024 01.

The instant petition has been filed seeking direction upon the respondents to pay compensation and the interest accrued thereon till date under the 'Right to fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 20l3' for the land measuring more than one kanal falling under khasra No. 67 and 68 situated at village Naili, Tehsil Thanna Mandi and District Rajouri in which respondents have constructed road from Haspalote to Dhoke.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 20l3
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Further, learned counsel for the petitioner seek compensation for the fruitful and non-fruitful trees growing on the same land and to provide an alternate land in the same vicinity to the petitioner on the basis of current market value of the land along with jabrana as the petitioner was dependent on the said cultivatable land for his livelihood which the respondents have occupied without paying any compensation and without adopting due process of law.
02.
Reply has been filed by the respondents wherein it has been affirmed that the road namely 'Hasplote to Dhoke' has been constructed under PMGSY.

The Chief Engineer PMGSY Jammu Vide Communication no CEJ/PMGSY/117-20 dated 04-04-2022 has placed indent for acquisition of land coming under Hasptote to Dhoke road under 'Right to fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 20l3'.

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 20l3
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Further as part of the land acquisition proceedings, the office of the Tehsildar Thannamandi has been directed by the Collector land Mohd. Rashid vs Ut Of J&K And Ors on 9 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67459030/
1 Acquisition (Sub Divisional Magistrate) Thannamandi to prepare land papers for acquisition of Land.
The preparation of land papers is at final stage.

03. At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner would feel satisfied in case the writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondents to conclude the process strictly in terms of the reply filed by the respondents and release the compensation in favour of the petitioners within a reasonable time limit.

04. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
05.

The instant writ petition is disposed of by directing respondent nos. 2 to 4 to conclude the proceedings of land acquisition under the Right to fair compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 20l3' and pay the compensation to the rightful owners strictly in accordance with law within a period of two months from the date of passing of this order.
06. Disposed of accordingly.
(MOKSHA KHAJURIA KAZMI) JUDGE Jammu:
